description: Provision a Google Cloud Monitoring MonitoringGroup via Config Connector. Fields mirror the monitoring.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 MonitoringGroup spec.

displayName.description: A user-assigned name for this group, used only for display purposes.

filter.description: The filter used to determine which monitored resources belong to this group.

isCluster.description: If true, the members of this group are considered to be a cluster. The system can perform additional analysis on groups that are clusters.

parentRef.description: MonitoringGroupRef is a reference to a GCP MonitoringGroup. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed MonitoringGroup resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/groups/{{groupID}}".

name.description: The name of a MonitoringGroup resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a MonitoringGroup resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: Immutable. The Project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The service-generated name of the resource. Used for acquisition only. Leave unset to create a new resource.

title: GCP Monitoring MonitoringGroup
